verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that PlanetScale lets you view current and previous usage per database and query cluster pricing with SQL. Viewing usage and looking up prices are adjacent features, not spend caps or usage alerts that would prevent a surprise bill. Nothing in the pack documents budget limits, spend thresholds, or billing notifications.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spend caps or usage alerts so a runaway query or traffic spike cannot produce a surprise bill
